text:
ellie (Product Designer): quick thread on the alert preview: users keep confusing the suppression control with a notification channel. current layout: [badge][badge][badge][suppress pill]. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/def456.png

owen (PM): seen that in user testing too. they click the pill expecting channel filters. we should either separate it visually or move it into the row actions.

sam (Frontend): a couple of low-effort options: 1) add a 1px divider between badges and the pill (pseudo-element), 2) move pill to actions area, 3) add a tiny caption under the pill in compact rows saying "Suppress".

ellie (Product Designer): i prototyped the divider + extra breathing space in figma. it reduces mis-clicks in the flow tests. attaching fig: file://figma/compact-suppress-divider-v2

nate (Accessibility): a11y considerations: if divider is purely decorative it must be aria-hidden. more importantly, the pill should be implemented as role="switch" with aria-checked and a visible label for screen reader users. Also focus ring needs to be high-contrast in both light/dark modes.

sam (Frontend): agreed on role=switch. current code uses `<button class="pill">` so small change. for focus I tried this: ```css
.pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-on-surface); outline-offset: 2px; }
``` works but on dark backgrounds the color needs tweaking.

ellie (Product Designer): can we avoid a thick ring? it feels heavy next to small badges. maybe inner ring + glow? will test microcopy too.

nate (Accessibility): inner ring ok if contrast meets 3:1 with adjacent surface. also ensure `:focus-visible` only shows for keyboard users (not mouse) to avoid flash. for SRs: include a visually-hidden `<span>` that updates to "Suppression on" / "Suppression off" when toggled so users get explicit feedback.

owen (PM): timeline? we'd like to have a prototype for the customer preview next Wed.

sam (Frontend): i can spin up a branch with pseudo-element divider and role=switch by EOD Friday. will include a dark-mode token so design can tweak without code changes.

ellie (Product Designer): thanks. one more UX ask: when suppression is on, the preview panel currently hides the channel badges which confuses users. let's keep badges visible but dim them (30% opacity) and show a small badge that says "Muted".

nate (Accessibility): don't rely on opacity alone to convey state. pair dimming with an explicit text label (visually or SR-only) so users with contrast needs aren't left guessing.

sam (Frontend): implementation note: will add `.badge--dimmed { opacity: 0.3; filter: grayscale(20%); }` plus `aria-hidden` adjustments for decorative icons. also add `data-suppress-state` attribute on the row for easy selectors.

ellie (Product Designer): lovely. i'll update the figma and post the preview link here once updated. :sparkles:

ui-bot: uploaded "compact-suppress-divider-v2.fig" to the thread.
